shots.motion: Two women stand still on an empty night platform in light drizzle, the minute hand of a big clock moves, the mother clutches a tin
A local train glides into a night platform and slows to a stop, its headlight glowing, light rain
Camera pans to an old man sitting by the open train door, warm light pulses softly around him, he looks up
An old man slowly takes off his round glasses, eyes filling with tears, a tear rolls down his cheek
A woman kneels slowly and touches the feet of a seated old man, her shoulders shaking with emotion
An old wrinkled hand lowers gently onto the head of a kneeling woman in blessing, warm light glows
A young woman with tears on her face steps forward and smiles, wiping a tear
An old man puts his glasses back on and chuckles softly, hand on his chest
A young woman speaks through tears to an old man by the train door, he nods slowly, warm light
Wind stirs an old man white hair as he looks out of the open train door into the dawn sky and closes his eyes peacefully
A train bursts out of a tunnel into golden sunrise, warm light floods through the windows and blooms
Golden light settles on an empty train seat with a small tiffin and a jasmine flower, a petal stirs in the breeze
Slow push in on a brass memorial plaque on a railway pillar, a marigold garland sways gently, commuters blur past
A hand touches a brass plaque, the wristwatch second hand starts moving again
A crowded morning local train rushes past in a blur while two women stand still together on the platform, slow pull back
